title: fix(cli): route the generated app layout's icon lookup through the platform seam
body:
Fixes #7472

`packages/cli/src/utils/app-generator.ts` emitted a lucide icon resolver **into the generated user application** — an eighth copy, the last container in the platform still resolving icon names for itself. objectui#5935's ruling, quoted verbatim and untranslated because the wording is the operative clause:

> 本裁定后新容器 ⛔ 不得再自带解析器,一律走 seam

The generated `src/Layout.tsx` now imports `LazyIcon` and `isLucideIconName` from `@object-ui/components` — already a declared dependency of the generated manifest, so the specifier resolves from the **generated app's own dependency graph**, never by a path back into this repo (the objectui#7525 trap). The four statically-referenced icons become named imports, so the wildcard namespace import is gone from generated apps entirely.

## Re-measured on this branch's base, not copied off the card

The card wrote `:842`; triage read `:843` at `a472b07`. Base here is `origin/main` at `9ba7e9c3a2`:

```
$ git show 9ba7e9c3a2:packages/cli/src/utils/app-generator.ts | grep -n 'lucideIcons\['
843:  const Icon = lucideIcons[name];
```

The resolver declaration itself opens at `:842`. Both readings were right about their own tree.

## ⭐ The seam question the un-hold comment left open, settled

The un-hold (`#issuecomment-5653747779`) released on a probe whose `iconNameMap` half did **not** match, and asked the taker to settle whether the seam is actually usable for this call site. It is, and the missing half is not needed:

- The seam's public entry re-exports `getLazyIcon`, `isLucideIconName`, `LazyIcon`, `toKebabIconName` (`packages/components/src/index.ts:42`). `@object-ui/components` is already in `PLATFORM_RUNTIME_PACKAGES`, so the generated manifest declares it.
- The seam holds the **vocabulary internally** — a `Set` built from `lucide-react`'s own `iconNames` export. A caller that calls `LazyIcon` / `isLucideIconName` never needs a name map. An `iconNameMap`-shaped single copy would only be needed by a consumer doing its own resolution, which is exactly what this change removes.
- Corroborating: the census gate's own reading has moved from the card's `182 authored/declared names reaching 7 record-reading resolvers` to `184 ... reaching 1 record-reading resolver`. objectui#5935's consolidation landed.

⇒ ⛔ No reversal to `pm:on-hold` is warranted.

## ⛔ What this deliberately does not touch

`scripts/check-lucide-icon-record-names.mjs` and its `DECLARED_RECORD_READERS` are untouched. The card's most valuable move was refusing the tempting conclusion that a census miss is a census bug: this site was invisible for three independent structural reasons, so its absence from the declaration was **correct**. The template was what diverged, and the template is what moved.

## ⚠️ Migration — measured, and NOT the risk triage predicted

Triage's boundary note warned that "若某个已生成的应用依赖裸 `PascalCase`,升级 CLI 后它的图标会消失". **Measured false for the canonical spellings.** The replaced lookup indexed lucide's named-export namespace; the seam accepts `toKebabIconName(name)`, and converting canonical PascalCase is exactly what that tokeniser is for.

Measured against `lucide-react@1.35.0`, populations named in words:

| population | count | after |
|:--|--:|:--|
| `lucide-react` namespace export keys (the old vocabulary) | 6,110 | — |
| canonical kebab icon names (the seam's vocabulary) | 2,039 | — |
| component keys that still resolve | 1,882 | unchanged |
| canonical kebab names the namespace index rejected | 2,039 | **gained** |
| `*Icon` suffix aliases (`HouseIcon`) | 2,037 | **lost** |
| `Lucide*` prefix aliases (`LucideHouse`) | 2,036 | **lost** |
| digit-suffixed names (`Building2`) | 147 | **lost** |

So the narrowing is real but narrow in kind: it is lucide's **alias** spellings, which were never `icons` keys and therefore resolved inside a generated app and nowhere else in the platform. An `app.json` using one should switch to the canonical spelling — `House`, or `building-2`. The gain direction is that `kebab-case`, which every other container already accepted, now works here too.

The 147 digit-suffixed names are a gap in the **seam's tokeniser**, not in this change, and they are lost platform-wide rather than only here. Filed separately as objectui#9414 rather than fixed on this branch — widening the tokeniser changes behaviour for every censused resolver at once, and this card's fence is explicit that the seam contract is not to be re-opened here.

## Tests

The claim splits across two packages, and the split is forced rather than a preference.

- **Wiring**, in `packages/cli/src/__tests__/app-generator.test.ts`, judged over the same file map the CLI writes: no self-rolled lookup remains; the seam is imported from a package the generated manifest declares; no `../` escapes the generated app; and a self-test plants the pre-fix lookup back and confirms the predicate reports it. The routed fixture now carries an `icon` at every menu level — until now the only authored name any test put through the resolver was `logo`.
- **Behaviour**, in the new `packages/components/src/__tests__/lazy-icon-generated-app-contract-7472.test.ts`: every name the CLI fixture authors, plus the one the template hardcodes, put through the real seam via the package's public entry, with a rejection control that hits in the same run.

The seam cannot be imported from the CLI's own `src/` by its package specifier: `@object-ui/cli` declares `@object-ui/components` as a runtime dependency for a reason no scanner can see, and that reason is carried by a `DECLARED_WITHOUT_IMPORT` row in `scripts/check-unused-dependencies.mjs`. A package import there makes the row stale and erases the only written record of why the declaration is not a devDependency. So the names cross the boundary as data, pinned identically on both sides.

Also re-pinned: `check-test-path-roots.mjs`'s registry entry for `app-generator.test.ts`, whose line the insertion moved.

### Readings

All at `90c3c6fbb0`. Heavy runs went through the container's shared verify lock, so wall-clock figures are shared-box seconds.

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/cli/ \
  packages/components/src/__tests__/lazy-icon-generated-app-contract-7472.test.ts \
  scripts/__tests__/check-test-path-roots.test.ts \
  scripts/__tests__/check-unused-dependencies.test.ts
  => Test Files 20 passed (20) · Tests 333 passed (333)

pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/
  => Test Files 271 passed (271) · Tests 2613 passed (2613)

pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli run type-check         => exit 0  (program includes the test file, verified with --listFiles)
pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check  => exit 0  (tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json)
pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli run lint               => 0 errors
pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run lint        => 0 errors

check:icon-record-names  exit 0  OK  lucide icon names: 184 authored/declared names reaching 1 record-reading resolver are live `icons` keys
check:unused-deps        exit 0  Every gated declaration has a consumer in the package that declares it.
check:phantom-deps       exit 0  Every in-scope import is declared by the package that publishes it.
check:test-path-roots    exit 0
check:control-bytes      exit 0
check:self-import        exit 0
check-changeset-presence exit 0  3 source file(s) of 2 released package(s) changed, 1 changeset declared
```

eslint was run on the four changed source files with `--no-inline-config --format json`: 4 files linted, 0 errors, 1 warning. The repo-wide `eslint .` sweep is left to CI.

### Reverse verification

Both ablations ran from the committed tree, with the mutation proven on disk before the run and the restore proven by an empty `git diff HEAD` after it.

**A — revert the template.** Code-only readers (this file both contains import statements inside a string literal and discusses them in prose, so a naive grep reads the prose as code; the first attempt did exactly that and was re-run):

```
namespace-import lines      0 -> 1
lucideIcons[...] index lines 0 -> 1
CONTROL, comment lines mentioning the namespace import, must hit: 1
blob 5a4ebf1b89 -> 4479a1c737
  => Tests 4 failed | 43 passed, incl. "rolls no icon-name resolver of its own"
```

**B — drop `isLucideIconName` from the seam's public entry.** This is the leg that proves the cross-package guard has teeth, since the generated app's own tsc run cannot resolve `@object-ui/*` and would sail past a rename:

```
lines naming isLucideIconName on the entry  1 -> 0
CONTROL, total export statements on the entry: 24
blob a05a471bd5 -> 8a11e12f33
  => Tests 7 failed (7) — the whole contract file
```

## ⚠️ Routing, reported rather than changed

Triage assigned `domain:devx` but recorded the counter-argument and explicitly did not lock it: because the resolver is generated into user applications, its vocabulary is arguably a product contract. Having done the work, I read `domain:devx` as the better fit — the change lands on a code-generation template and its gates, and the only product-surface file touched is a test. Reporting, not relabelling; this seat does not produce a `domain:` label.

Held as **draft** pending review.
